obernants.operator: Duplicates return early, so recursive best distance is positive. At initial delta²=best, each half has internal separation >=delta. A strip of width 2delta and height delta partitions in each half into constant many cells of diameter <delta; hence constant many candidates per point, even with boundary ties. Re-sorting strips gives T(n)=2T(n/2)+O(n log n), O(n log²n); sequential recursion peaks at O(n) vectors.
